records.statement: Poller skip-first-run returns once only when enabled and isFirstRun. Acquire runs before try: acquisition failure/false does not invoke release. Successful acquire wraps runPollerCycle in finally release. Each fetched job enters try/catch/finally: eligibility PENDING and (maxRuns absent OR runCount<maxRuns); execute saves IN_PROGRESS before executor; catch sets ERROR then saves; finally refresh runs even after failures. Refresh failure exits cycle but outer release is still attempted; release failure replaces pending completion. Loop header getNextJob runs before its per-job try. Source guards and explicit finally discriminants are retained, without proving runtime branch feasibility.

records.statement: Base execute runs selected local Retry/Default implementation, then increments runCount and totalRunCount independently (null to zero), persists updateJobAfterRun before notification. Config changes reset runCount only, not totalRunCount. Eligibility uses runCount; completion uses totalRunCount>=maxRuns, or expiration strictly now.isAfter(expiresAt), or completed status. Strategy next time is evaluated against Instant.now; lastRetryOnExpire TRUE may select expiresAt.

records.statement: ConfigService job and registration overloads have distinct cart-line null handling. Match requires nonnull conditions, equal retry state and each list empty OR contains. Zero/multiple matches throw the source-specific exceptions; reduce keeps a sole matching element and invokes its throwing binary reducer only for a subsequent match. ConfigMapper private Map.of selects exactly one of three instance helpers by strategy type. Objects.requireNonNull checks relevant fields. Runtime CronStrategy uses UNIX and system default zone, while validator parses SPRING. Fixed rate uses initialDelay only before first run; intervals select runCount index, null count first element, exhausted index null. No positivity/bounds constraints beyond explicit source validation are assumed.

records.statement: Retry mapper writes only explicit builder fields, omitting retryStrategy even though the entity declares and fromEntity reads it. Null runCount/totalRunCount normalize to zero in persistence mapping. Save distinguishes absent/single/multiple existing rows, maps a replacement and preserves existing id/created. Register returns the original built job and ignores mapped save return; assignNextRunAt may mutate that same reference. Existing retry response is 208, new is 200; outer HTTP response/envelope is distinct from inner DTO and nullable Integer to primitive int conversion remains conditional.

records.statement: Retry calls the locally declared POST payment-session retry Feign interface using stored params.paymentSessionId and selects getData from whole response. getLastRetryState selects maximum attemptedAt in retry history; notification separately uses response.getLastRecurringChargeState().toBuilder().nextRetryAt(job.nextRunAt). Stored params.recurringChargeId is Kafka key; event payload identifiers/retryStrategy come from remote response. Metadata explicit source fields are UUID id, epoch-second created, correlationId, imported PAYMENT_INTEGRATION_SERVICE source display name, RECURRING_CHARGE name and VERSION_1. Local Kafka sendMessage passes topic/key/event unchanged and registers whenComplete logging without await, retry or save. Imported DTO definitions/wire fields and runtime transport remain gaps.
